title: Strict finite singleton augmentation maps for a residue-zero section
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l and X a scheme. Write O for the constant small-site section ring and q for its first residue map [def-sfb-internal-completion-section-transport]. Let a be a global section of O whose image under q is zero on every site object. For every, possibly unbounded, complex P of actual integral internal modules [sk-def-pe-derived-completion], there are chain maps v_n from complex(P) tensor the level-n dual singleton Koszul complex [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system] to the actual transported positive quotient complex at n [def-sfb-internal-quotient-tower-model]. Composing the degree-zero tensor unit with v_n gives the actual quotient unit. The restriction of v_n to every total-tensor summand of nonzero Koszul degree is zero. The v_n commute with the successor transitions. No K-flatness, quasi-isomorphism, or inverse-limit assertion is made.

source.place: Lemma derived-completion-koszul (0A0E), singleton augmentation; also proetale.tex, Section derived-completion-noetherian (099L) and Lemma naive-completion (099M).

proof.text: Use the singleton scalar-cone presentation for N=complex(P), obtaining e_n: N tensor Q_n isomorphic to cone(f_n) with its normalized unit, off-degree-zero projection vanishing and successor projection equations.

The residue-kernel power annihilation theorem gives f_n followed by the right unitor and actual quotient unit equal to zero. Use mappingCone.desc with zero homotopy and this quotient map to define w_n: cone(f_n) to quotients(P)_n. Set v_n=e_n.hom followed by w_n. Its composite with the cone inclusion is the specified quotient map, so the normalized unit equation follows by cancellation of the tensor right unitor.

The degree-q component of w_n is the second cone projection followed by the right unitor and quotient unit. Hence its composite with a nonzero Koszul-degree summand vanishes, by the cone presentation. The successor projection equation and naturality of quotientUnits give the transition identity degreewise; complex extensionality finishes. These are applications of mappingCone.desc_f and the category composition laws.

lean.statement:
theorem koszul_finite_augmentation
    (a : ((ring l E X).obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections)
    (ha : ∀ U : Scheme.coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, u} X,
      (residue l E X).hom.app (op U) (a.val (op U)) = 0)
    (P : CochainComplex (AdicCompletion.Modules l E X) ℤ) :
    ∃ v : ∀ n : ℕ,
        ((ringedKoszulTensorTower (ring l E X) 1 (fun _ ↦ a)).obj
          (complex l E X P)).obj (op n) ⟶ (quotients l E X P).obj (op n),
      (∀ n, ringedKoszulTensorUnitComponent (ring l E X) 1 (fun _ ↦ a)
          (complex l E X P) (op n) ≫ v n = (quotientUnits l E X P).app (op n)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (p j : ℤ), j ≠ 0 →
        HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor (complex l E X P)
            ((ringedKoszulDualTower (ring l E X) 1 (fun _ ↦ a)).obj (op n))
            (curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ) p j (p + j) rfl ≫ (v n).f (p + j) = 0) ∧
      (∀ n, ((ringedKoszulTensorTower (ring l E X) 1 (fun _ ↦ a)).obj
          (complex l E X P)).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right n 1)).op ≫ v n =
        v (n + 1) ≫ (quotients l E X P).map
          (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right n 1)).op)
